name: idt
description: NagrikSetu is an intelligent civic issue tracking and management platform that connects citizens with local authorities. By leveraging a modern Web Stack and advanced Machine Learning (NLP & Clustering), it automates issue categorization, determines urgency, and prevents duplicate reports.

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:chatbot" "npm run start:ml"
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../chatbot-service && npm install && cd ../ml-service && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
